topic: Practical on documentation based on following maintenance evolutions:- Part 4 U/S log of MOD form 700C for an equipment removal / fitment, P
syllabus_extract: Practical on documentation based on following maintenance evolutions:- Part 4 U/S log of MOD form 700C for an equipment removal / fitment, Progressing routine inspections, out of phase operations / servicing due as per Part 6 D, E, F and re-forecasting, A defect observed in any system during flying or on ground, Any limitation and husbandry defects as in Part 2A& 2B with their entries clearing procedure in Part 4, Any defect cleared by DI/DR, Any defect cleared by robbing action, Any defect cleared by replacement of component and forecasting its life, Entries made for grounding / CTF / MTF, Acceptance of A/C and clearing in Part 4 by pilot for Ground run, CTF & MTF, Documentation linked to independent checks, supervisory checks and checks on special occasions.
specific_objectives: 21.1.5.1 Trainee will be able to explain the procedure of removal and fitment of various LRUs i.a.w ASM
